incident.title: Uploaded images fail to save
incident.description: Since 10:00 UTC our editors cannot upload images. The upload finishes with a server error, while existing articles remain readable. We uploaded a large batch of media yesterday. We have not checked storage usage.

context.reported_change: Customer reports a large media upload the previous day; not independently verified.
context.reported_impact: New media uploads fail; existing article reads reportedly work.
